histogram.name: SmartSelection.Suggestions.Latency.{Stage}
histogram.summary: Records the duration of {Stage} during a Smart Selection Suggestions server request. Uses a custom 1 ms to 20 s range (50 buckets) to preserve 1 ms resolution for fast sub-stages while covering the 20 s default request timeout. Recorded when a valid SmartSelectionSuggestionsResponse is received (and, for server-side stages, when the corresponding latency field is populated in the response).

variant.name: ClientMesRpc
variant.summary: the client-observed round-trip MES ExecuteModel RPC

variant.name: ClientPrep
variant.summary: client-side request preparation and screenshot encoding

variant.name: EndToEnd
variant.summary: the end-to-end request from RequestSuggestions to response receipt

variant.name: MesImagePrep
variant.summary: MES server-side image decoding, cropping/marking, and encoding

variant.name: MesOtherOverhead
variant.summary: MES server-side overhead outside image preprocessing and model execution

variant.name: MesOverhead
variant.summary: total MES server-side overhead outside model execution

variant.name: ModelContentProc
variant.summary: multimodal content processing and tokenization in the model backend

variant.name: ModelDecode
variant.summary: output token decoding on the model server

variant.name: ModelDecodeQueueWait
variant.summary: queue wait before decode starts on the model server

variant.name: ModelOther
variant.summary: model execution time not accounted for by content processing, prefill queue wait, prefill, decode queue wait, and decode

variant.name: ModelPrefill
variant.summary: prompt prefill on the model server

variant.name: ModelPrefillQueueWait
variant.summary: queue wait before prefill starts on the model server

variant.name: ModelRun
variant.summary: the backend GenerateContent RPC from MES to the model service

variant.name: Transmission
variant.summary: network transmission and client/edge RPC overhead (ClientMesRpc minus MesTotal)

histogram.name: SmartSelection.Suggestions.Request.ApcSize
histogram.summary: The serialized size (in KB) of the AnnotatedPageContent proto sent in a Smart Selection Suggestions server request. Recorded when a valid SmartSelectionSuggestionsResponse is received.

histogram.name: SmartSelection.Suggestions.Request.ImageSize
histogram.summary: The encoded byte size (in KB) of the screenshot sent in a Smart Selection Suggestions server request. Recorded when a valid SmartSelectionSuggestionsResponse is received.

histogram.name: SmartSelection.Suggestions.Response.SuggestionCount
histogram.summary: The number of valid suggestions extracted from a SmartSelectionSuggestionsResponse. Recorded when a valid response is received from the server.
